tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Use this to read the full document for an id returned by search: a statute section’s official text, or a court decision’s DavisStirling summary followed by the start of the opinion, with source and currency information. Do not use it to search; use search first to get an id.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
